keyword: how to watch the masters today
claims: The final round of the 2026 Masters is on Sunday, April 12.
CBS provides TV coverage from 2:00 PM to 7:00 PM ET.
Paramount+ provides streaming from 2:00 PM to 7:00 PM ET.
CBS Sports Network airs an encore of the final round on Sunday at 8:00 PM ET.
Masters.com provides free streaming coverage including Featured Groups at 10:15 AM and Amen Corner at 11:45 AM.
The Masters App provides free streaming coverage including Featured Groups at 10:15 AM and Amen Corner at 11:45 AM.
Featured Groups coverage is from 10:15 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. ET on Paramount+ and the Masters App.
Amen Corner coverage is from 11:45 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. ET on Paramount+ and the Masters App.
Holes 4, 5, and 6 coverage is from 10:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. ET on Paramount+ and the Masters App.
Holes 15 and 16 coverage is from 11:45 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. ET on Paramount+ and the Masters App.
